Look: click and drag the view (or press [ and ] to turn), or move the mouse and hold the cursor near the left or right edge to keep turning. Click the view for full FPS mouse-lock (Esc releases it). If anything glitches, use the Reset button (or Backspace). Eye height is 5.5 ft.
